newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol sees lower tax burden in H2 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Endemol sees lower tax burden in H2 96/97.

text.p: Television production company Endemol Entertainment NV said on Tuesday it planned to reduce its overall tax rate by taking advantage of new Dutch legislation governing finance subsidiaries.
This was expected to reduce its tax burden from the second half of the current 1996/97 financial year which ends on July 31, the company said in a statement on first-half results.
"The tax rate will certainly be lower," said Endemol spokesman Thomas Notermans.

He added that the company was still in talks with the Dutch finance ministry and that it was not yet clear how much lower the tax rate would be from the second half of the current 1996/1997 financial year.
